issues.detail: Thread TH2 has 12 messages and TH3 has 10 messages, both falling below the expected minimum of 15 messages per thread.
Task T12 is listed in the blueprint's artifacts_to_reference for TH5, but it does not appear in the artifact_refs of any message in that thread.
